title: TAB Racing Day Scene Plan

headlineCategory.description: Fresh LLM generation is instructed to emit this for every Scene 8. It remains schema-optional for previously stored-plan recovery and for the explicit post-validation Scene 8 quality-fallback exception defined in scene-contracts.json. Category meaning, eligibility and diversity policy are owned by scene-contracts.json.

semanticValidation: Planner may apply context-safe deterministic canonicalization before semantic validation. It never reorders Scene 2/5/8 primary chronology or splits/merges/moves Scene 8. When exactly one Scene 4 exists and primary coverage is canonical, planner code owns its final midpoint placement and checkpointAfterBetSequence; any LLM-supplied checkpoint value is discarded/overwritten. Builder independently repeats deterministic midpoint validation before rendering.
Scene 1 first exactly once; Scene 6 second-last exactly once; Scene 7 last exactly once.

Scene 4 at most once; if present planner code places it at the actual Scene2/5/8 primary boundary minimizing abs(completed/totalBets - 0.5), earlier tie, and sets checkpointAfterBetSequence to that completed-primary sequence. If the boundary ends in Scene2 with attached Scene3, Scene4 follows that replay. Never split Scene8 for midpoint.
Every input bet sequence appears exactly once as primary coverage in Scene 2, Scene 5 or Scene 8; Scene 3 never counts.
Primary coverage is ascending with no gaps, duplicates or reordering.
Scene 5 contains exactly 2 or 3 consecutive ascending sequences.

Scene 8 contains exactly 4 or 5 consecutive ascending sequences and comments.length must equal betSequences.length. Fresh LLM generation is instructed to emit headlineCategory; the field remains schema-optional for stored-plan recovery and the explicit post-validation quality-fallback exception. Category meaning, eligibility and diversity policy are owned by scene-contracts.json.

Scene 8 pre-result headlines are deterministically rejected when code can mechanically prove an obvious grouped-result leak, including explicit outcome language, outcome-derived money values that are not valid pre-result facts, and explicit grouped finishing-position disclosure. Subtle semantic spoilers that cannot be proved safely by deterministic checks remain planner-prompt and live-inspection responsibilities.
Scene 3 immediately follows Scene 2 for same sequence and requires WIN + showReplay=true + replayUrl; Scene3 may not attach to Scene5 or Scene8.

Planner fields only: FACT, builder-DERIVED, CONTROLLED and RUNTIME fields are forbidden. checkpointAfterBetSequence is the sole planner-code-owned structural field and is never authoritative from LLM output.
Planner and builder enforce word/character limits and factual-grounding/markup prose policy from scene-contracts.json.
Planner and builder deterministically calculate planned duration from runtime-contract.json. Conservative planned duration must not exceed the hard maximum.

Scene 8 headlineCategory meaning, eligibility and diversity are a fresh-generation quality gate. After all hard plan validation has passed, runtime may use the scene-contracts.json quality-fallback exception when the optional headline-only repair is skipped for time budget or fails validation.
Natural-language quality and any no-spoiler meaning beyond the mechanically provable Scene 8 guard remain planner-prompt responsibilities.
